summary: Overnight the risk backdrop eased at the margin: the ten-year yield fell to 4.65 from 4.69, the two-year to 4.19 from 4.25, the ten-year real rate to 2.4 from 2.43, high-yield spreads tightened to 2.7 from 2.71, and the VIX slipped to 14.9 from 15.15. That nudged the total risk score down 0.61 to 42.48, still in caution with a goldilocks regime. The macro dimension remains the most stretched at 61.87, anchored by a 2.4 real rate at the 98th percentile and a 4.65 ten-year at the 97th percentile, even as the latest prints show disinflation (CPI 4.17 to 3.46, core CPI 2.82 to 2.57, PCE 3.42 to 3.29). The clearest crack is the labor market: payrolls collapsed from 20.0 to -23.0 while continuing claims rose from 1777000 to 1801000 and participation fell from 61.5 to 61.4. Semiconductors are the weak spot (semis relative -3.05, Networking -3.68, Semiconductor Equipment -3.03; NVDA -2.86, AMD -2.86, MU -1.89), though the Memory theme bucked the trend at +2.24 amid Korean-broker target cuts. Software and cloud stayed bid (Cloud Computing +2.95, Cybersecurity +2.81, AI Software +2.29). The dominant catalyst is tomorrow's July CPI print.

top_risk_drivers.claim: The real rate at 2.4 sits at the 98th percentile and the ten-year yield at 4.65 at the 97th percentile, keeping the macro dimension the most stretched at 61.87 even as nominal rates ease.

Payrolls collapsed from 20.0 to -23.0, continuing claims rose from 1777000 to 1801000, and participation slipped from 61.5 to 61.4, the clearest deterioration beneath a still-low 4.1 unemployment rate.
Semiconductors are the weak spot: semis relative -3.05, Networking -3.68, Semiconductor Equipment -3.03, with NVDA -2.86, AMD -2.86, MU -1.89, even as the Memory theme bucked the trend at +2.24.

Cross-asset confirmation is only 0.625, the largest single contribution yet still partial, leaving room for the geopolitical supply premium (U.S. oil above 84 dollars, aluminum at a seven-day high) to reprice.

Headline disinflation is clear (CPI 4.17 to 3.46, core CPI 2.82 to 2.57, PCE 3.42 to 3.29) but inflation expectations are drifting up (five-year 2.28 to 2.33, ten-year breakeven 2.25 to 2.29) while the Fedwatch-implied rate holds at 3.69 and officials stay hawkish.

supporting_signals.claim: Rates eased across the curve: the ten-year 4.69 to 4.65, the two-year 4.25 to 4.19, the real rate 2.43 to 2.4, SOFR 3.65 to 3.62, and reverse repo 1.45 to 0.975.
Volatility compressed as the VIX fell from 15.15 to 14.9 and realized volatility held at 14.0037.
Software and cloud stayed bid with Cloud Computing +2.95, Cybersecurity +2.81, AI Software +2.29, and Enterprise Software +2.26.

contradicting_signals.claim: Breadth is healthy at 0.6645 above the two-hundred-day average, yet the new-highs ratio is only 0.0968 and the fifty-two-week drawdown is -0.0297, so the rally is narrow.
Crypto did not confirm the risk easing, with BTC -1.24466, ETH -1.87183, SOL -1.00926.
A-share memory names diverged from the Korean-broker cuts: Goke Micro -0.18, Jiangbolong +1.21, while Cambricon -1.75, a mixed session read rather than a clean risk signal.

what_changed_today: Rates fell across the curve: ten-year 4.69 to 4.65, two-year 4.25 to 4.19, real rate 2.43 to 2.4.
Labor data deteriorated: payrolls 20.0 to -23.0, continuing claims 1777000 to 1801000.
Inflation prints showed disinflation: CPI 4.17 to 3.46, core CPI 2.82 to 2.57, PCE 3.42 to 3.29.
Semiconductors weakened: semis relative -3.05, Networking -3.68, NVDA -2.86, AMD -2.86, MU -1.89.
watch_next: July CPI print due tomorrow (high importance); a soft reading extends the disinflation trade, a hot one revives the hike path.
Fed speakers including Hammack stay hawkish; watch the Fedwatch-implied rate near 3.69 and any repricing of the front end.
Hormuz deadlock and oil above 84 dollars; a deal that reopens the strait would relieve the supply premium, a failed one extends it.
Memory-sector top risk after Korean brokers cut Samsung and SK Hynix targets about 30 percent; watch A-share memory names for confirmation.

bull_case.title: Bull case: rates ease further and CPI confirms disinflation
points: If tomorrow's CPI prints soft, the ten-year could extend below 4.65, the real rate at 2.4 relief pressures the macro dimension below 61.87, and the goldilocks regime holds.
Software and cloud leadership (Cloud +2.95, Cybersecurity +2.81, AI Software +2.29) broadens beyond semis, supported by healthy breadth at 0.6645.

base_case.title: Base case: range-bound caution into CPI
points: The total score holds near 42.48 in caution; macro stays the stretched leg at 61.87 while volatility at 23.23 and liquidity-credit at 33.74 offset it.
Markets wait on tomorrow's CPI; cross-asset confirmation at 0.625 keeps conviction low and ranges tight.

bear_case.title: Bear case: hotter CPI relights the hike path
points: A hot CPI pushes the ten-year back above 4.69 and the real rate above 2.43, re-stretching macro toward 61.87 and beyond as the Fed turns hawkish.
Labor cracks deepen: payrolls at -23.0 and continuing claims at 1801000 signal a slowdown that, with sticky inflation, revives stagflation worries.
